scope: Local implementation of sub-slice S2-1 of docs/QR_4_QUALIFIED_SELECTION_CONTRACT.md (RC-S21 to RC-S28) for PM-1 row F10-03: the qualified-selection registration tables as an offline PostgreSQL extension (registrations with a database-clock registration time, universe rows, participants tied to the hashed body and to validated F09 exports, an insert-only status log whose pinned transition table equals src/selection/lifecycle.js, a marker), QR002, QR003 and QR004 guards, a deferred commit check, a rollback that refuses while any QR-4 row or QR4_SELECTION register row exists, an install, inspect and rollback tool, and src/postgres/selection-store.js with registerSelection, cancelSelection, an owner-scoped readSelection that compares rows with the body, and readSearchedWindows. src/selection/hash.js now exports registrationBody. Nothing is installed on staging and no route writes these tables.
method: An architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) wrote the S2 design and root accepted it (RC-S21 to RC-S27). A coder (Sonnet 5.5) wrote S2-1. An independent architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) and a second-opinion reviewer (Fable 5.1) reviewed rounds 1 and 2; both found in round 1, and Opus confirmed with a probe, that participant rows could be added after registration. An independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) ran the PostgreSQL suites and single-edit mutations after each of three rounds. A sole-runner tester then ran, with nothing else active, test/postgres/runtime-grants.test.mjs and every new extension file one file per process on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster (fail 0 and skipped 0 in each), the install, inspect and rollback sequence of all three new tools with the repo grant script, test/postgres-runtime-grants.test.js and the full unit suite (2115 tests, 0 fail, 6 skipped, 9 todo). Root ruled on every finding. Nobody verified their own work.

result: test/postgres/quant-selection.test.mjs 15 of 15 and test/postgres/quant-selection-register.test.mjs 26 of 26 pass with 0 skipped; the tool sequence exits 0 and inspect with the runtime role reports no failures; the pure selection tests still pass in the full unit suite.

mutations.round3: 2 of 2 killed (run_id compare, guard-name pin derived from the SQL).

limits: Sub-slice S2-1 only: the RO-12 rechecks, window freeze, evaluation starts, outcome and replay (S2-2), the evaluation job (S3) and the API do not exist.
S2-2 must add the EVALUATING-origin acceptance oracle and admit a QR4_SELECTION register row only after FIRST_EVALUATION_START.
The tie tolerances (OD-S3) are still unset by the owner, so no real registration can pass; tests use an injected registry.
Not installed on staging; installation needs the F09 builder extension first and a fresh owner GO.
Column collation is not classified yet (cross-extension hardening slice).

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the design, the agent reports, the rulings, the sole-runner verification and the final diff and accepted S2-1 as local engineering evidence for F10-03. Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself, installs nothing and writes no row.
